doc.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20

title: Army band and the Albert system clarinet
summary: Drafted in 1918 into the 815th Pioneer Infantry band, he was made to play Albert system clarinet and studied with Herman Good.
